pages.text: These smaller dinosaurs are cunning and agile, and are not to be underestimated when fighting in packs. They can be easily controlled and summoned using their favorite dinosaur nuggets.

Wearing Wild Robe restores your dinosaurs' health. Feeding them any kind of meat heals your Vallumraptors. Dinosaur nuggets can be used to breed your Vallumraptors; a breeding pair will lay an egg, and the hatchling will still recognize you as its master.
